estimates.assumptions: Large onion estimated at ~150g edible portion (typical medium-large onion is 100-200g; using upper end for 'large').
'1 chopped' pork assumed to be one standard tonkatsu cutlet (~120g raw boneless pork loin, common in katsudon recipes; calorie density matches lean pork).
Standard 1 tsp mirin = ~5g; ~250 kcal/100g is realistic for sweet rice wine (high sugar content).
'Chopped' chives for garnish estimated at modest 5g total (small handful; typical for 2 servings).
